name: authorize_cli
description: Mint the single-use PKCE authorization code that lets the Oxagen CLI obtain an API key for one org and workspace after the signed-in person consents.

codeChallenge.description: Base64url SHA-256 of the CLI's PKCE code_verifier (RFC 7636)

codeChallengeMethod.description: The PKCE transform; S256 is the only accepted method

redirectUri.description: The CLI's loopback listener (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/…); the handler refuses any non-loopback target

label.description: Human label for the API key the code will be exchanged for

state.description: The CLI's CSRF token; the consent page echoes it on the loopback redirect and the invocation records it

code.description: The single-use authorization code, valid for five minutes, to send to the loopback redirect
